title: Where does the computation go?
description: Compare attention, routed parameters, recurrent depth and the systems that execute them.

roles.attention: Route a destination query to source keys and combine their value vectors.
roles.mixture-of-experts: Spend parameter computation on a routed subset of experts for each token.
roles.recurrent-depth: Spend additional sequential steps by reusing the same block parameters.
roles.kv-cache: Account for the growing inference state retained for earlier token positions.
roles.efficient-attention: Separate fewer permitted reads from a more efficient implementation of the same reads.
roles.state-space: Compress past inputs into a recurrent state with input-dependent retention and writes.

title: What is the model predicting?
description: Contrast tokens, sensory observations, learned representations and future actions.

roles.training-decoding: Score shifted next-token targets, then generate unknown tokens during inference.
roles.jepa: Predict selected target representations from visible context rather than reconstruct pixels.
roles.video-world-models: Predict future latent states, with an action interface when used for planning.
roles.diffusion-flow: Learn to recover or transport structured samples from a specified noisy state.
roles.predictive-coding: Compare neighboring activities with local predictions during inference.
roles.action-models: Predict a distribution over robot action tokens or continuous action chunks.

title: What can change in a learning system?
description: Explore gradients, local activities, evolved topology and persistent memory.

roles.backprop-biology: Propagate a loss derivative to parameter updates and examine the required signals.
roles.pc-alm: Change inferred activities and dual multipliers before the parameter update.
roles.neat: Change directly encoded connection weights and topology through evolution.
roles.hyperneat: Change a coordinate-based generator that expresses task-network connectivity.
roles.continual-learning: Update useful behavior while measuring what earlier tasks retain or lose.
roles.memory-adaptation: Distinguish context, external stores, adapters and test-time parameters by what survives reset.

title: How does prediction become action?
description: Connect representation learning to beliefs, planning, policies and external evaluation.

roles.multimodal-fusion: Choose how observations and instructions enter the policy representation.
roles.video-world-models: Evaluate candidate action-conditioned futures against a planning objective.
roles.active-inference: Compare policies through beliefs, preferences and a specified expected-free-energy convention.
roles.vla-foundations: Connect visual and language conditioning to an action interface inside a feedback loop.
roles.action-models: Choose the action distribution, sample a horizon and execute a prefix.
roles.robot-evaluation: Measure the timed perception–action loop and task outcomes under disturbances.

title: How can we inspect what a Transformer computes?
description: Follow representations into vocabulary readouts, local sensitivities and causal intervention tests.

roles.token-embeddings: Locate the input vectors and output decoder that frame later readouts.
roles.residual-streams: Identify the layer-and-token state where a measurement or intervention is made.
roles.transformer-observability: Match each measurement to the kind of evidence it can support.
roles.logit-tuned-lenses: Decode intermediate states through an explicit vocabulary readout or fitted translator.
roles.jacobian-lens: Transport hidden states using averaged downstream sensitivities and inspect the limits.
roles.causal-features-circuits: Replace activations, rerun downstream computation and evaluate candidate causal explanations.
